introHtml: LED light buttons, stickers, and patches add visibility and fun to any promotional campaign. Unlike standard lapel pins or embroidered patches, these items feature built-in LED lights that flash or stay lit, making them ideal for night events, safety giveaways, or concerts. Decorate with your logo using full-color imprinting on the face. Choose from battery-powered options that last for hours. Perfect for trade shows, marathons, or employee safety kits where you want your brand to stand out in the dark.
